title: STM32L496RGT6 UART sourcing current capacity
content:
Hi,

We have configured PB11 and PC4 for UART. when UART send data, what is pin current sourcing capacity?

/Anurag

scraped_replies.html: See the datasheet for the GPIO specifications - it’s not specific to what Alternate Function is used (eg, UART).

Hello ​@Anuraglokhande 
It is stated in the product datasheet Output driving current section that The GPIOs (general purpose input/outputs) can sink or source up to ±8 mA, and sink or source up to ± 20 mA (with a relaxed VOL/VOH). GPIOs PC13, PC14 and PC15 are supplied through the power switch, limiting source capability up to 3 mA only.
You can review the datasheet for more details
BR
Gyessine
